text:
emily (sales): Kicking off Nightingale POC perf plan — goal: 500 qps sustained for chat completions, p95 < 220ms on 256-token prompts. Need SE/perf ops to own orchestration and metrics. Raj (prospect) will be in loop. Target run window: Tue-Thu this week. Who can own the run + final report?

Tom (se): I can own orchestration. Plan to run primarily on Dedicated-2 (8x A100 equivalent) with hosted fallback. Which model variants are we testing exactly?

Raj (nightingale): We're validating rwd-3b and rwd-7b-quant. Workload split: 85% chat completions (~35 token responses avg), 15% batch embeddings. Security: KMS required, and we'll need answers to our vendor questionnaire.

Anika (perf): Proposed load plan:
1) Warmup 30m @200 qps
2) Step ramp 200 -> 500 over 15m
3) Sustain 500 qps for 60m
4) Spike tests: 1k qps bursts x5 (30s each)
Collect: per-request latency, p50/p95/p99, per-token time, GPU util, queue length, and request tracing. Instrument with rt-trace and ship artifacts to perf-s3. Enable continuous batching + prefix KV cache.

Tom (se): Also add routing validation: send 10% of traffic to quant variant as a compatibility/fallback check. Include a controlled cold-start test: kill one worker mid-sustain and observe tail behavior.

Emily (sales): Raj asked about pricing: what's the estimated cost for a 72h Dedicated run with this profile? Also what's our fallback SLA if Dedicated capacity degrades during the sustain phase?

Anika (perf): Ballpark cost for Dedicated-2 (per-node A100 pricing) — I'll DM exact numbers to the thread (will include GPU-hours and egress). For immediate purposes: expect a few thousand USD for an intensive 72h run. Fallback: we can auto-route to hosted rwd-7b-embed which increases p95 by ~30-50ms; ops policy will fall back automatically if node health drops.

Lucy (security): Quick flag: if Nightingale will send PHI in prompts, we must run on Private deployment with customer-managed KMS and a signed DPA. Raj — can you confirm whether PHI will be present in the test data? Also need contact for the security questionnaire.

Raj (nightingale): Yes — a small subset of prompts will include PHI for acceptance tests. We'll need Private + KMS. Security contact is melissa@nightingale.com — she'll send the questionnaire.

deploy-bot: test-run started (run id: run-4821) — collecting traces to s3://perf-nightingale/run-4821 — warmup ETA 30m.

Anika (perf): Warmup observations at ~250 qps on rwd-7b-quant: p95 ~180ms, p99 ~410ms, GPU util ~78%. Looks stable so far. I'll continue monitoring and post intermediate graphs.

Emily (sales): Tom/Anika — can you produce a 1-page acceptance criteria + estimated cost summary for Raj so his procurement team has what they need? I'll add a note about the Private lead time (~2 weeks for KMS onboarding) and the DPA.

Tom (se): On it. Adding quick runbook snippet to the artifacts: 
```
# starter load command
locust -f tests/load.py --users 500 --spawn-rate 50 --headless \
  --run-id run-4821 --target-url https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# env: REDWOOD_DEPLOY=dedicated-2
```
Also enabling KV prefix caching and continuous batching in the serving config.

Anika (perf): After sustain completes I'll produce a CSV results file with columns: timestamp,qps,p50,p95,p99,avg_latency,gpu_util,queue_len,model_variant. Will upload graphs + CSV to s3 and link here.

deploy-bot: run-4821 finished sustain phase. Artifacts: s3://perf-nightingale/run-4821/results.csv, s3://perf-nightingale/run-4821/trace.tar.gz. Summary: sustained 500 qps for 60m; overall p95 = 212ms, p99 = 480ms, avg latency = 98ms.

Raj (nightingale): Nice work — can you include a monthly ops estimate if we scale to 1k qps sustained? Also melissa will DM Lucy for the security questionnaire.

Emily (sales): I'll get finance to produce a 1k qps monthly ops estimate and a formal quote. Next steps: Anika to upload full results + cost estimate, Tom to finalize runbook + fallback doc, Lucy to coordinate KMS/Private onboarding with melissa. Thanks team!
